# Assets · Logos

3 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for atta-logo.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Logos

Tres versiones en SVG. `atta-logo.svg` va sobre `fondo` claro (#f7f1e6): hormiga en `culona` (#a0381a), hoja en `hoja` (#2f6b35) y wordmark en `tinta` (#24170f). `atta-logo-oscuro.svg` va sobre fondo oscuro (#17110d): hormiga #e57a52, hoja #7cc283, wordmark #f4eadb. `atta-marca.svg` es solo la hormiga con la hoja, en los colores de la versión clara, para favicon y avatares. Margen mínimo: la altura de la cabeza de la hormiga.
